rules.statement: Confluence stacking: OB+FVG+BPR + session H/L + origin-of-move + liquidity + 50%-of-move + channel; graded, never all-boxes veto
Session trigger: Asia H/L break + 5m/15m (+1h) candle close = direction; session start gives direction in first ~1-1.5h
Magnet doctrine: unmitigated levels / unretested orb breakouts / unfilled gaps / resting stops act as price draws ('they will go to that level')
Entry mechanics: limit at zone ('cheat code'; documentary Limit Long/Buy labels) or snipe after mitigation; enter-at-publish = official follower rule

Stop beyond structure; width grows with level type and with mitigated/unmitigated levels or sweep risk between entry and stop; posted-width median ~$20-21 across quarters; stop-feasibility veto ('level too big' = no trade)
Anticipatory follower BE: move SL to entry at +50-60p BEFORE instruction; BE-scratch is accepted rent for runners; never-widen binds follower lanes (ratified)
Layered entries 3-5 tranches, one shared stop; close-worst/hold-best; BE at average for layered; cap ~3 adds; 50/30/20 & 30/30+run schedules
R2b: after the range you don't enter again (his own rule); re-entry chains violate it and produced both verified SL losses
rules.status: REPEATED_OBSERVATION + HISTORICAL_REPLAY_SUPPORTED (R2b best single protector +10.6/+17.8 uplift)

rules.statement: Central caveat: posted lane != his book (earlier fills, wider/adaptive stops, Vantage feed); documented posted-vs-actual SL gap ~$5 (19-Mar); 'paper trade but I took it on my real account'
Claim conventions: win% = W/(W+L) with BE/MISSED/REMOVED excluded; no-entry 'wins' exist; claims inflate vs follower-capturable (~+699p illusory); discount lane-5 always
Displacement evidence = FVG artifact: impulsive move that leaves FVG => strong OB; no-FVG one-leg move = sweep/'weak break' (loss-backed)
